test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 10 Jan 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Three different positions of the same dice are shown. Find the number on the face opposite the face showing '4'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ed40444e2e51ef2b3616925649fc0d97adb5d2de48ffa6cdfdd9a0e6a3ab18dc.png]
solution:
The pattern followed here is:

Logic: No two opposite faces are adjacent to each other.

Let's find which number is faced opposite to face having '4'.

We are taking both dice figures (1) & (2) together.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fa63b64e616cc4833744091e9d598ae8fa2d7f28886cdb90d3c9efdf500a15db.png] 

Here, 4 are common in both dice.

Now, we are taking dice figures (1) & (2) together.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/17ba59d66a8af7aa32f675ff462d41282b1ac4e1888cb4c97936608fa553d451.png] 

Here, 4 is common in both the dice and the rotated clockwise direction.

Opposite pairs:

⇒ 5 ⇔ 1

⇒ 2 ⇔ 6

⇒ 4 ⇔ 3

Clearly, 4 is the opposite of 3.

Hence, the correct answer is "3".
